svg.title: Myers' search on the edit graph of ABCABBA and CBABAC: in each round d, the furthest point d edits can reach on each diagonal, until one is the far corner
svg.text: a, x: a step right deletes a line of a
b, y: a step down inserts

g.title: Round d = 0: no edit yet. From (0,0) the search follows diagonal 0 while the lines are equal: A is not C, so the snake is 0 long and (0,0) is as far as no edits go.
g.text: kept: x on each diagonal k

g.title: Round d = 1: one more edit from round 0's points, down or right, whichever lands further on, then a free snake: k -1 (0,1), k 1 (1,0).
g.text: kept: x on each diagonal k

g.title: Round d = 2: one more edit from round 1's points, down or right, whichever lands further on, then a free snake: k -2 (2,4), k 0 (2,2), k 2 (3,1).
g.text: kept: x on each diagonal k

g.title: Round d = 3: one more edit from round 2's points, down or right, whichever lands further on, then a free snake: k -3 (3,6), k -1 (4,5), k 1 (5,4), k 3 (5,2).
g.text: kept: x on each diagonal k

g.title: Round d = 4: one more edit from round 3's points, down or right, whichever lands further on, then a free snake: k -4 (3,7), k -2 (4,6), k 0 (5,5), k 2 (7,5), k 4 (7,3). (3,7) is past the end of b: kept, never on a path.
g.text: kept: x on each diagonal k

g.title: Round d = 5: diagonal 1 reaches (7,6), the far corner, and the search stops: the shortest script has 5 edits. (3,8) and (4,7) are past the end of b: kept, never on a path.
g.text: kept: x on each diagonal k

g.title: The walk back from (7,6): each round's point came from round d-1's on diagonal k+1 or k-1, by the same rule. The path is 5 edits and 4 kept lines, a shortest script.
g.text: kept: x on each diagonal k
kept: CABA, 4 lines, as many as
